title: aider-shim-reaches-into-inference-domain
intention: aider_shim's interceptor.py imports inference_domain.domain, inference_domain.host, and reads inference_domain/stacks/models.json by hardcoded path — three encapsulation violations. A device may not reach into another device's internals.
why: Akien 2026-08-30: 'IT MAY NOT DO THIS. THIS IS A SERIOUS FAILURE OF ENCAPSULATION. THE ONLY SHIM THAT MAY BE SORT OF REACHED INTO IS THE DATABASE BECAUSE ITS DESIGNED TO BE OPEN.' The failure surfaced as 3 broken proofs when inference_domain/stacks/ was restructured into inference_domain/machines/route/stacks/. The path broke because it was never supposed to exist — a device reaching into another device's file tree is the bug, not the moved file.
traces_to: Law 6 (everything has exactly one owner — a device's internals are gated by the device), the shim-routes-everything ruling (a device's shim routes everything that device routes), and the provider-doesn't-know-consumers principle (the consumer asks for what it wants through the provider's interface, not by reaching in).

falsifier.proves_red: Done when aider_shim contains zero imports from cairn.devices.inference_domain and zero hardcoded paths into inference_domain's file tree. Wrong intent if the fix just updates the path to the new location.
falsifier.horizon: The aider_shim device is disabled (probes/ renamed to probes_disabled/) until this is fixed. Three proof files fail: test_driver, test_fence, test_interceptor.

how: The interceptor needs model resolution and host selection. inference_domain already provides these as capabilities. The fix: aider_shim asks inference_domain through its public interface, not by importing its internals. The three violations: (1) line 190: from cairn.devices.inference_domain import domain, (2) line 196: from cairn.devices.inference_domain import host, (3) lines 413-414: hardcoded path traversal to inference_domain/stacks/models.json.

decisions.text: WHERE THE BUILD STANDS (2026-09-17, CC). Of the three violations the how names, (1) and (2) — the direct imports of domain and host at the old lines 190/196 — were already gone before this build: interceptor.build()'s inner _do_resolve() uses bus.request(sender='aider_shim', to='inference_domain', verb='resolve', why='aider completion', body=request)['body'] when a bus is given, and otherwise the tool seam from cairn.tools.bus_client import inference_seam (a tool holds the one import; a tool has users, not owners — Law 6). Only violation (3) remained: interceptor._stack() walked Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'devices' / 'inference_domain' / 'machines' / 'route' / 'stacks' / 'models.json'. This build removes that walk and touches exactly four files: cairn/devices/aider_shim/interceptor.py, cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py, cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py (+ its __init__.py export list), and the NEW proof cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_no_direct_reach.py. The 'dependencies' field ('inference_domain must expose a public interface for model resolution and host selection') is satisfied by the models view below plus the existing resolve verb; the stale 2026-09-08 queue on e194f4b4cb3e was released by set_phase (its why is in phase_writes) because the falsifier is a source measurement and the bus door the fix rides pre-dates e194.

decisions.text: THE OWNER'S NEW VIEW. In cairn/devices/inference_domain/device.py, InferenceDomainDevice.declared_views() now returns {'yield': self._yield_view, 'models': self._models_view}, and the new method is exactly: def _models_view(self) -> dict: (docstring) from cairn.devices.inference_domain.machines.route.route import load_stacks; return load_stacks()['models']. load_stacks(stacks_dir=None) already existed at cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/route.py and returns {'providers','models','combos','domains'} parsed from that device's own stacks/ directory. BaseDevice._handle_get (cairn/tools/base/device.py) already dispatches verb 'get' with body {'what': '<view>'} to declared_views()[what]() and replies {'accepted': True, 'verb': 'get', 'view': what, 'device': <id>, 'data': <the view's return>} — so nothing else was needed for 'models' to be askable over the bus.

decisions.text: THE REPAIRED FUNCTION, VERBATIM. cairn/devices/aider_shim/interceptor.py now reads: def _stack(models_stack, bus=None): (docstring) if models_stack is not None: return models_stack / if bus is not None: reply = bus.request(sender='aider_shim', to='inference_domain', verb='get', why="aider's model_cost table is the stack the owner declares", body={'what': 'models'}); return reply['body']['data'] / from cairn.tools.bus_client import models_stack as _seam  # noqa: PLC0415 / return _seam(). And build() resolves it ONCE, right after 'log = log if log is not None else SeenLog(record_path=DEFAULT_RECORD)': models_stack = _stack(models_stack, bus) — so _model_cost(models_stack, fence) at 'mod.model_cost = ...' and _model_info(model, models_stack, fence) inside get_model_info() receive an already-resolved dict and their signatures are unchanged. build()'s docstring sentence 'the fallback is direct import of inference_domain' became 'the fallback is the bus_client seam (subprocess use only) — this device imports nothing from inference_domain and names no path into its tree.' No other line of interceptor.py changed.

decisions.text: THE PROOF — cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_no_direct_reach.py, pytest-shaped, ending with: if __name__ == '__main__': from cairn.tools.proof_coverage import print_teeth_main; raise SystemExit(print_teeth_main(__file__)). PROVES = {'50ad391f4e95': {'1': 'test_no_module_in_aider_shim_imports_inference_domain', '2': 'test_no_module_in_aider_shim_spells_a_path_into_inference_domain', '3': 'test_the_surface_asks_the_bus_for_the_models_stack'}} — clause 1 = zero imports, clause 2 = zero hardcoded paths, clause 3 = the wrong-intent clause (the reach was replaced by a door, not repointed). Eight teeth: test_the_device_has_modules_to_measure (the census is not vacuous); tooth 1 ast-walks every .py under cairn/devices/aider_shim/ except the proofs/ folder and fails on any Import/ImportFrom whose module is cairn.devices.inference_domain or starts with it plus a dot; tooth 2 fails on any string Constant that carries 'inference_domain/' or equals 'inference_domain' while being an operand of a '/' BinOp (the Path walk shape) — a bare 'inference_domain' elsewhere is the bus ADDRESS and is allowed; test_the_instrument_would_catch_a_repointed_path writes three tmp files and asserts the scanner reds a repointed Path walk and a joined 'cairn/devices/inference_domain/.../models.json' string and passes to='inference_domain'; tooth 3 builds the surface with a _FakeBus whose request(**kw) records kw, asserts to=='inference_domain', verb=='get', body=={'what': 'models'} and answers {'body': {'accepted': True, 'verb': 'get', 'view': 'models', 'device': 'inference_domain', 'data': stack}} for stack={'models': [{'name': 'fixture-model:1b'}, {'name': 'other-model:7b'}]} — then asserts exactly one ask, sender 'aider_shim', set(mod.model_cost) == both names, get_model_info('fixture-model:1b')['max_output_tokens'] == Fence().reply_headroom, and get_model_info('gpt-4o') raises KeyError; test_an_injected_stack_never_touches_the_bus builds with models_stack given and a bus whose request raises; test_inference_domain_declares_a_models_view_that_returns_the_stack calls InferenceDomainDevice().declared_verbs()['get']({'body': {'what': 'models'}}) and asserts accepted, view=='models' and 'qwen3-coder:30b' among data['models'] names; test_the_seam_answers_the_same_stack_as_the_view asserts bus_client.models_stack() == the view's return. Names under test are imported inside each tooth. Run: PYTHONPATH=. python3 cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_no_direct_reach.py -> 8 passed, twice. The four pre-existing aider_shim proofs (test_driver, test_fence, test_interceptor, test_translation) print GREEN twice after the change; inference_domain's test_resolve_verb and test_inference_domain and bus_client's three proofs are green.

build()'s signature, verbatim, at cairn/devices/aider_shim/interceptor.py:156-157: def build(*, resolver=None, fence: Fence | None = None, log: SeenLog | None = None, models_stack=None, resolve=None, bus=None, ticket: str = '') -> types.ModuleType: — so models_stack and bus are both keyword parameters of build(), models_stack defaulting to None, and the new line models_stack = _stack(models_stack, bus) rebinds that parameter with the resolved dict. It is the fourth statement of the body, after fence = fence or Fence() and log = log if log is not None else SeenLog(record_path=DEFAULT_RECORD) and before mod = _Surface(MODULE_NAME).

NO NEW FIXTURE NEEDS THE REAL BUS OR THE DRIVER. The proof is self-contained and needs no reference to bus.py or driver.py: the only fixture is the class in the proof file, verbatim — class _FakeBus: def __init__(self, stack): self.stack = stack; self.seen = [] / def request(self, **kw): self.seen.append(kw); assert kw['to'] == 'inference_domain'; assert kw['verb'] == 'get'; assert kw['body'] == {'what': 'models'}; return {'body': {'accepted': True, 'verb': 'get', 'view': 'models', 'device': 'inference_domain', 'data': self.stack}}. It stands in for the bus because interceptor only ever calls bus.request(**keywords) and reads reply['body'] — the same shape the existing _do_resolve relies on. The surface is built in the door teeth as interceptor.build(bus=bus, fence=Fence(), log=SeenLog(), resolver=object()) (Fence and SeenLog from cairn.devices.aider_shim.fence; resolver=object() is a placeholder never called because no completion is asked). The ast helpers are ordinary stdlib: _device_modules() = sorted(p for p in DEVICE.rglob('*.py') if 'proofs' not in p.relative_to(DEVICE).parts) with DEVICE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; _imports_of(path) yields alias.name for ast.Import and node.module or '' for ast.ImportFrom over ast.walk(ast.parse(path.read_text())); _path_literals_of(path) first collects id(side) for every ast.Constant that is left or right of an ast.BinOp whose op is ast.Div, then yields every str Constant v where 'inference_domain/' in v, or v == 'inference_domain' and id(node) is in that set. FORBIDDEN_MODULE = 'cairn.devices.inference_domain'; FORBIDDEN_PATH_PARTS = ('inference_domain',). test_the_instrument_would_catch_a_repointed_path takes pytest's tmp_path and writes three files: one with HERE = Path(__file__).parents[3] / 'somewhere_else' / 'inference_domain' / 'stacks' (must yield ['inference_domain']), one with P = 'cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/stacks/models.json' (must yield non-empty), one with bus.request(sender='aider_shim', to='inference_domain', verb='get') (must yield []).
